description: In monkeys trained to report a visual target, spiking in V1 and V2 was uncorrelated with perception, while low-frequency modulation of local field potentials, presumed to come from synchronously firing neurons, in the same regions did correlate with it (Wilke et al. 2006, as reported by McFadden).
limitations: Reported secondhand in McFadden 2020. The original study is not read here.

sources.quote: spiking of neurons in cortical areas V1 and V2 was totally uncorrelated with the monkey’s perception of the target
